title.zh: a16z押注本地 AI 助手Underdog：邮件和日历都留在自己电脑里
title.en: a16z押注本地 AI 助手Underdog：邮件和日历都留在自己电脑里

current_state.zh: Conway Research launched Underdog, a locally-run Mac AI assistant backed by an a16z-led round, shipping a 4B open model (Woof) and a Husky inference engine that benchmarks up to 4.5x faster than MLX on Apple Silicon, with plans to expand to iPhone, Windows, Linux, Android and NVIDIA devices.
